upcoming.title: You don't have an AI problem. You have six tabs.
upcoming.hook: YOU DON'T HAVE AN AI PROBLEM
upcoming.idea: One tool for notes, one for email, one for scheduling, one for content — and none of them talk to each other. So the founder becomes the integration layer, copying output between tabs by hand. That is not automation, it is a second job. Real automation is one workflow that runs end to end with nobody in the middle. Before adding another tool, ask what it connects to.

upcoming.title: Most people are using AI like a jet engine as a fan
upcoming.hook: A JET ENGINE USED AS A FAN
upcoming.idea: You ask AI a question, it answers, you copy the answer somewhere else. That is the smallest version of what it does. The shift now is AI that runs the whole workflow — reads the email, decides what it is, routes it, drafts the reply, books the follow-up. You just approve. Same technology, completely different leverage.

posted.title: Your AI isn't underperforming. Nobody gave it a job.
